question: Great Depression after World War I

answers: The Great Depression started in the United States after a major fall in stock prices that began around September 4 , 1929 , and became worldwide news with the stock market crash of October 29 , 1929 ( known as Black Tuesday ) . . Between 1929 and 1932 , worldwide gross domestic product ( GDP ) fell by an estimated 15 % .It was also largely caused by the decision of most western nations after World War I to return to the gold standard at the pre-war gold price .  By 1931 , the world was reeling from the worst depression of recent memory , and the entire structure of reparations and war debts collapsed .

The German hyper-inflationary period that occurred after World War I was caused by several factors, one of which was the heavy tribute that Germany had to pay in the form of war reparation. The Weimar Republic printed trillions of marks , causing extremely high inflation of the German currency. The burden became unbearable after the Great Depression. Nonetheless , even the payment of this small percentage of the original reparations ( 132 billion gold marks ) still placed a significant burden on the German economy . Although the causes of the devastating post-war hyperinflation are complex and disputed , Germans blamed the near - collapse of their economy on the Treaty of Versailles, and some economists estimated that the reparations accounted for as much as one - third of the hyper - inflation .

The First World War began in 1914 when a Serbian backed organization assassinated the heir of the Austro - Hungarian throne, no - one could stop the conflict and the First World War broke out . It lasted to the final Armistice in 1918 . The Allied Powers , led by the British Empire , France , Russia until March 1918 , Japan and the United States after 1917 , defeated the Central Powers , led by the German Empire , Austro - Hungarian Empire and the Ottoman Empire.It is also called as the Great War , or the War to End All Wars.More than 70 million military personnel , including 60 million Europeans , were mobilised in one of the largest wars in history . Over nine million combatants and seven million civilians died as a result of the war ( including the victims of a number of genocides ) , a casualty rate exacerbated by the belligerents ' technological and industrial sophistication , and the tactical stalemate caused by gruelling trench warfare . It was one of the deadliest conflicts in history , and paved the way for major political changes , including revolutions in many of the nations involved . Unresolved rivalries still extant at the end of the conflict contributed to the start of the Second World War only twenty - one years later .
